description: This file is a test script for a git merging behavior, specifically focusing on handling file mode changes during merge operations. It sets up various scenarios involving file mode modifications, deletions, and merges, then checks the outcomes to ensure correct merge strategies are applied.

methods.name: do_one_mode
methods.description: Performs a merge with a specified strategy between two branches and verifies the executable bit of the file after the merge.

methods.name: do_both_modes
methods.description: Tests conflict detection when both branches change the file mode with a specified merge strategy.

methods.name: do_delete_modechange
methods.description: Checks for conflicts when one branch deletes a file while another changes its mode.
